title: Shared definitions
description: Types used by more than one PublicDataToolkit record. See STANDARD.md.

id.description: A short identifier: letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-', starting with a letter or digit.

name.description: A variable name exactly as the publisher spells it in this release, case included.

code.description: A value as stored in the data file. Numbers stay numbers. Stata extended missing values are written as strings such as ".d"; SAS special missing values as ".A".

wave.description: One wave of data collection, in the dataset's own terms: a survey year (1972), a panel wave ("W2"), a cycle ("2022-2023"), or a portal snapshot date.

redistribution.description: ship: may be redistributed (in git or a release). build-only: users must get it from the publisher; we ship only code that builds from it. unknown: not yet reviewed; nothing built from it may ship.

missing_type.description: Why a value is missing. One code can carry several types, e.g. GSS NA(m) "dk, na, iap". unknown: the source records the value as unknown (administrative and coded data, e.g. a police report). unspecified: the source marks the code missing but gives no reason (GSS .z "see codebook"). See STANDARD.md §4.2.

origin_kind.description: Where a fact came from. See STANDARD.md §3.

origin.description: Provenance for one fact or a group of facts.

source.description: Id of the file in sources.yaml the fact was read from.

location.description: Where in the source: a page, a section heading, a URL fragment, a line.

rule.description: Name of the rule that produced the fact, e.g. missing_from_label_regex.

model.description: Model id, when origin is model.

author.description: Who made a hand judgment, or reviewed a model draft: a person, or an agent and its task ("Claude (PublicDataToolkit Task 35)"). Never a person who didn't make or check it.

reviewed.description: For model output: whether a person has checked it.

variable_ref.description: Points at one variable. dataset defaults to this repo's dataset; release is required wherever the same name could mean different things in different releases. table is required when the name appears in more than one table of the release.

extensions.description: Dataset-specific fields the standard doesn't model yet, namespaced by dataset id: {"gss": {...}}. Every key used here should be listed, with a reason, in the repo's EXTENSIONS.md.
